assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Single authentic Vietnamese GÀ Ủ MUỐI HOA TIÊU restaurant dish photograph, landscape 4:3. The identity of this exact dish is critical. A HALF small Vietnamese native chicken salt-cured with herbs, gently cooked and chilled, skin an EVEN DISTINCT RICH GOLDEN TURMERIC YELLOW, taut firm thin skin tightly adhering to firm compact meat. Fully cooked dense meat has a subtle pale rosy beige cured appearance, clean smooth cut surfaces. Half chicken cleaver-cut crosswise into 6-7 substantial orderly segments then reassembled in its original half-chicken shape, skin upwards, one intact drumstick at the front side, thigh and breast visibly coherent. The look is traditional Vietnamese chilled salt-cured yellow chicken, NOT a pile of fluffy boiled chicken scraps, NOT roast chicken, NOT grilled. A simple round white ceramic platter lined with a single banana leaf, a tiny portion of rau ram and thin kaffir lime leaf strips, small dish of chili lime salt at side. Chicken dominates with identifiable golden skin, no excessive garnish. A simple real Vietnamese restaurant wooden tabletop. Soft neutral window daylight, natural shadows, realistic camera photograph at 45 degree overhead, modest honest family restaurant plating, no studio glamour. Skin yellow should be unmistakable yet natural turmeric staining, not fluorescent orange or neon. No pale gray skin, no wrinkled boiled skin, no loose shredded meat, no brown grilled skin, no oversaturation, no wet plastic sheen, no smoke, no raw bloody meat, no star anise or cinnamon props, no decorative background clutter, no letters, no watermarks. Center whole platter with crop-safe margins; single photograph, no collage.
